title: Iran warns of widening conflict, accuses regional states of aiding US strikes

ai.summary: Iran warned of expanding conflict if US makes mistakes, accusing regional states of aiding US strikes and criticizing IAEA's bias on nuclear issues.

facts.claim: Iran has warned that the geographical scope of the ongoing conflict could expand if the United States makes what it called a mistake
facts.quote: Iran has warned that the geographical scope of the ongoing conflict could expand if the United States makes what it called a mistake

facts.claim: Iran accused regional countries of facilitating American military strikes against Tehran
facts.quote: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said Tehran had documented evidence of regional countries assisting US attacks on Iran and had raised the matter through diplomatic channels

facts.claim: Iran claimed missiles, drones and aircraft launched from military bases in these countries demonstrated their involvement
facts.quote: He alleged that missiles, drones and aircraft launched from military bases in these countries, along with logistical support provided to US forces, demonstrated their involvement

facts.claim: Iran defended its attacks on neighbouring countries as 'purely defensive in nature'
facts.quote: No action has been taken by Iran against the sovereignty of these countries,
